scientific_integrity: The universal claim has a self-contained four-state combinatorial proof; finite verification tests the sharp boundary kernel but is not used as an infinite certificate. No assertion about independent validation or exhaustive bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, length at least six, forbidden overlap lengths exactly two and three; no error-correcting distance or classification of extremizers.
title: Exact capacity of binary \((2,3)\)-overlap-free codes
